meanings.english: expected to happen or be true

meanings.english: probably; used to say what is expected to happen
meanings.example: She will most likely arrive before noon.

synonyms.difference: likely 在 “be likely to” 中是本卡需要主动掌握的表达；probable 含义接近，但宾语、语气和固定搭配不一定相同。

antonyms.usage: 和 likely 的核心义形成对比；先在真实句子中判断是否确实构成反向关系。
